newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Hetman NIF considers convertible bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Polish Hetman NIF considers convertible bond issue.

text.p: Poland's National Investment Fund No 15 "Hetman" will decide at its general shareholders' meeting on A convertible bonds issue aimed at financing its investments, NIF spokesperson said on Monday.
"The planned issue could take place at year's end or early next year," Marta Fita told Reuters.

"We want to earmark the resources incurred by the issue for investments, among others, to purchase shares in the chip board maker Zaklady Plyt Wiorowych in Wieruszow and in the meat producer Zaklady Miesne in Ostroleka," she said. She did not give any further details. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
